fontFamilies.fontFamily: Bahnschrift, "DIN Alternate", "Franklin Gothic Medium", "Nimbus Sans Narrow", sans-serif-condensed, sans-serif
fontFamilies.name: Industrial

styles.css: body { overflow-x: clip; } .wp-site-blocks { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100vh; min-height: 100svh; } .wp-site-blocks > footer { margin-top: auto; } .wp-block-site-logo img { transition: filter 0.3s ease; } .wp-block-site-logo a:hover img { filter: none !important; } .wp-block-comment-author-name a { text-decoration: none; } .wp-block-comment-author-name a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .wp-block-comment-content { font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; } .comment-respond .comment-reply-title { font-family: var(--wp--preset--font-family--cal-sans); } .wp-block-post-comments-form input:not([type=submit]):not([type=checkbox]), .wp-block-post-comments-form textarea { border: 1px solid var(--wp--preset--color--black); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0.6em 0.75em; font-family: var(--wp--preset--font-family--system-ui); } .wp-block-post-comments-form input:focus, .wp-block-post-comments-form textarea:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--wp--preset--color--black); outline-offset: 1px; } .wp-block-post-comments-form .wp-block-button__link, .wp-block-post-comments-form input[type=submit] { background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--black); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--wp--preset--color--black); border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--wp--preset--font-family--system-ui); transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .wp-block-post-comments-form .wp-block-button__link:hover, .wp-block-post-comments-form input[type=submit]:hover { opacity: 0.8; }
